name: Pour Lords intro
description: The Red Nova Conspiracy — authored via @neocompose/cli.

p4.say: Helium-3, on the house. Ask the smugglers on Titan who signs the condensate manifests. And tell them the Lords want a better rate.

p2.say: We don't drain the sun — we WISH we could, the margins would be obscene. But someone's been underselling us solar condensate at half rate. Brokered through Titan. Always anonymous. It's embarrassing, frankly.

p1.say: WELL, WELL. A dirtsider at the Pour Lords' table. We sell fuel, friend. Power, by the liter. What's your poison?

options.label: Direct
options.text: Who's buying enough fuel to drain a star?

options.label: Flatter
options.text: Impressive operation. The whole system runs on you.

p2f.say: FINALLY, someone with taste. For that, you get a straight answer — a rare vintage around here:
